definitions.worse: key(a) > key(d), exact lexicographic (T90, T100, unmet, hazard); A2 harm definition
definitions.weak_robust: non-default a with key(a) <= key(d) for every VALIDATION member of the class
definitions.strict_robust: weak robust and key(a) < key(d) for at least one member
definitions.best_fixed_action: min members harmed, then max strictly improved, then max captured, then lowest id
